# Vendored Browser Libraries

- Mediabunny 1.65.1, MPL-2.0: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny
- gifenc 1.0.3, MIT: https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc
- Lucide 1.68.0, ISC: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

Mediabunny and gifenc are unmodified browser distribution files from their pinned npm packages. Lucide contains only the icons used by this application, bundled with esbuild 0.25.12. Adjacent LICENSE files contain their license terms. No CDN is needed at runtime. The media libraries are loaded only when exporting.
